found_by: two-episode smoke test before spending the approved pilot budget
defect: the free index announced the supersession as provenance, so the control condition received the answer without spending budget
record titles named the supersession relation, so the critical record was identifiable without opening it
observed: both conditions produced the correct decision on seed 0, so the task could not discriminate between them
fix: index exposes only the support link M<-R1, never the supersession
the supersession is discoverable only by following the provenance path and spending budget
the treatment names the record to revalidate, not the answer
a third status value unverified is allowed so an out-of-budget agent is not forced into a false dichotomy
retained: the defective run is kept as evidence and excluded from any effect estimate
